title: SeedlessDS frontend video configuration overlay
description: Only the video additions are described here. Apply alongside the feature 003 full configuration contract; defaults are applied by the loader without rewriting existing files.

video.description: All video output configuration preferences introduced by feature 004.

display_mode.description: auto and dual_screen use separate physical displays when available and a single-display layout otherwise; single_screen always uses the primary display.

swap_screens.description: Exchange physical display assignments in dual output, or top/bottom image positions within a single-display layout.

single_screen_layout.description: Both screens stacked vertically or arranged horizontally; ignored for effective dual output.
